contractEnforcements.scope: contracts/r3.0e/* (reason-codes + experiment + outcome + control-variables + case-timeline + follow-up-link + index). NON-PRODUCTION at E1: no rendererAdapter, no runtime consumer, no algorithm; no UI; no feature-registry entry. Per SKYLINE D12/E1 ruling: this phase MUST NOT extend the frozen R3.0B case-record schema body (the pre-existing experimentId / followUpCaseIds associations are id-only refs, NOT R3.0E-driven extensions).
contractEnforcements.experimentShapeContract: validateExperimentShape enforces closed key set (18 keys), closed status enum (draft/planned/applied/completed/abandoned/invalid), closed expectedDirection enum (increase/decrease/no_change), bounded magnitudeRange { min<=max, both finite }, mandatory baselineValue (finite number), mandatory non-empty stopConditions, mandatory non-empty validationPlan, bounded controlVariables / followUpCaseIds arrays, envelope byte cap 128 KiB.
contractEnforcements.outcomeShapeContract: validateOutcomeShape enforces closed outcome class enum (confirmed / partially_confirmed / contradicted / inconclusive / invalid_comparison / inconclusive_due_to_confounders), comparabilityScore in [0,1], bounded confounders / dataQualityIssues / sideEffects / limitations arrays, confounders-present invariant (must coexist with inconclusive_due_to_confounders class OR CONTROL_VARIABLE_MISSING limitation).
contractEnforcements.controlVariableShapeContract: validateControlVariableShape enforces closed key set, allowedRange { min<=max } when present, type-checked observed values.
contractEnforcements.caseTimelineShapeContract: validateCaseTimelineShape enforces closed event-kind enum, chronological ordering, bounded events array.
contractEnforcements.followUpLinkShapeContract: validateFollowUpLinkShape enforces non-self-link constraint, closed parentStatus enum (present/archived/deleted).
